column1: # PikaOS-v2 package fleet: the single source of truth for what v2/pkg-build.sh
# builds (mirrors repo-tools/workflows' "one list, one build implementation").
# Format: one "<org>/<name>" per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#'
# are ignored. The CI matrix and v2/ci/repo-index.sh both read this file.
# Scope: the PikaOS application suite plus the desktop environments, rebuilt for
# x86-64-v2 from git.pika-os.com and compiled against normal Debian sid (the
# builder image is Debian, not the PikaOS v3 repositories).
# Organisation: the list is grouped by org and, within an org, alphabetical.
# Grouping is documentation only -- nothing reads the comments, the CI matrix
# is just the flat list of slugs.
# Membership rules (deliberate, because the gitea holds ~650 repos)
#   * anything that ships a PikaOS main.sh packaging recipe (the fleet contract)
#   * the otter-shell aggregator, which builds the whole otter suite from one repo
#   * anything that hardcodes an x86-64 level outside pika-build-config
#   * upstream-patches/* -- 650 repos, but 626 of them are bare "Diff" trees with
#     no packaging at all. They are patch overlays against upstream, not
#     buildable packages, so there is nothing to port until each one is wrapped.
#   * repo-tools/*, images/*, website/* -- CI plumbing, ISO builders and web
#   * refind and the *-refind-* themes -- this image ships GRUB, not rEFInd
#     (see README); rEFInd is explicitly purged from the ISO.
#   * -git / -nightly / -legacy variants of a package that is already in the
#     zig-legacy). A release must not ship a moving target.
#   * the nvidia-driver-NNN version matrix -- 13 mutually exclusive builds of the
#     same driver. pika-nvidia-driver is the one entry point; the numbered ones
#     stay out until there is a reason to pin a specific branch.
# Anything commented out below has a specific reason recorded next to it.
# akondi-mime5: Build-Depends libkf5akonadi-dev (KF5), dropped from sid (KF6 only).
# otter-zenith is an aggregator, not a single app: it reads pins.json, clones
# every otter-* component repo at its pinned tag, builds the libotter-* SONAME
# shared libraries and all the apps, and installs them from one debian/ tree
# (~140 .install files). So the other 64 otter-shell repos are consumed *by*
# this package and must NOT be listed individually -- doing so would rebuild
# ISA shim: debian/rules passes `-Dcpu=x86_64_v3` to every zig build, so the
# whole shell would be v3 regardless of amd64-v2.sh.
# window managers, shells and desktop bundles (28)
# nvidia (4) -- see the membership rules for why not the whole matrix
# multimedia (16) -- includes the blender and obs-studio patch sets
# blender and obs-studio are the two heaviest builds in the fleet by a wide
# margin; see the notes on each.
# upstream repacks (4) -- third-party sources PikaOS maintains a fork of
# These do NOT follow the fleet contract: they never read pika-build-config.sh
# output}.sh and a checked-in .config, and they emit debs with bindeb-pkg.
# They are listed here because they are buildable from the gitea, but they need
# their own treatment -- see the ISA note below and the release notes.
# ISA shim: scripts/config.sh overrides the shipped .config (which is
# CONFIG_X86_64_VERSION=1, baseline) and forces the level at build time. All
# three force 3 upstream; v2/ci/isa-shims.txt rewrites that line to 2.
# non-LTS lines are superseded, and the scx/template repos are build tooling
# rather than kernels this image would boot.
